decisions.boundary_condition: Do not infer preferences for other room amenities, hotel types, destinations, dates, or prices.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotel rooms with both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
decisions.condition: When searching for or comparing hotel rooms.
decisions.default_action: Use both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge as soft amenity criteria.
decisions.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable options lack either amenity, confirm whether the preference should be relaxed rather than automatically rejecting them.
decisions.name: Prefer an in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotel rooms with both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
decisions.rationale: Repeated, consistent evidence supports a durable soft preference for the combination of an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge. The frozen representative remains unchanged.

decisions.boundary_condition: Treat free breakfast as a soft preference; do not infer a required breakfast quality standard.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.condition: When searching for or comparing hotels.
decisions.default_action: Prefer or surface hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax the preference when the user explicitly deprioritizes breakfast or chooses a hotel without it.
decisions.name: Free breakfast hotel preference
decisions.rationale: Multiple conversations support a recurring preference for free breakfast. Evidence about breakfast quality is mixed and appears only once, so the released policy appropriately retains free breakfast as a soft preference without adding a quality requirement.
